title: The status dashboard gets stuck on the first environment you check
statement: Our internal status dashboard is supposed to show live settings for whichever environment you ask about, but once it has shown one environment, every environment you check afterward comes back looking identical to the first one, both for a single environment's line and for the full dashboard, and it stays that way until the process restarts. Nobody is touching the underlying override data in between; asking again just replays whatever came back the very first time. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -q` to check when it's fixed.
notes: Needs python3 with the standard library only. Four modules: sources.py holds the (correct) defaults and per-environment overrides, cache.py is a small generic memoization helper with no opinion about what should vary a key, resolver.py merges a resolved environment's settings and memoizes the result, and report.py renders per-environment and aggregate dashboard text. The statement describes only the dashboard's user-visible behaviour and names no file. The bug is not where the symptom is printed: resolver.py memoizes the merged settings under a fixed key that ignores which environment was asked for, so the second environment resolved in a process silently gets the first one's settings back — and report.py's own dashboard() does the exact same thing independently, memoizing the joined text under a fixed key that ignores which environments were requested. Fixing only one leaves the other test failing, so the fix has to touch both resolver.py and report.py; finding both means reading cache.py's contract first (it hands back whatever was stored for a key and does not care what should vary it) and then checking every call site that uses it, not just the one nearest the symptom.
